purpose: retrospective research only; not a fifth production model; same-cohort 2025-2026 comparisons
evaluation_warning: 2025-2026 have been investigated in earlier development; these results are NOT independently untouched future validation
data_cutoff: All player rates use earlier SEASONS only, not same season or future seasons
rate_definitions: Prior IPL batter SR with 100-ball 130 SR smoothing; bowler runs per six legal balls with 120-ball 8.7-run smoothing. Charged runs approximated from batsman plus wides/no-balls.
not_next_ball_info: At each checkpoint player actors are from last completed delivery; may not be at crease/current bowler for next delivery.

models.player_prior_history_from: complete earlier IPL seasons only; excluded current season, all subsequent seasons, and live match beyond checkpoint
